followup: Spatial lookup avoidance: frame-plan crossing triangle bounds, envelope proof, branching, disjoint program/scissor split, and uniform/declaration cleanup. All additions are diagnostics and evidence, not production code.
nativeFollowup: Native GLES compiler dump, clean shader comparison, one valid desktop OpenGL replay baseline. Counter HUD and first query interposer returned no data. Later replay lost GPU context; no further replays. Raw captures excluded.
nativeProbeArchiveCaveats: Initial native-query C source is the no-data attempt, not a supported capture tool. Clean program hook was narrowed before valid timing captures. RenderDoc controller initially accepted stale notifications; corrected controller and initial source both retained. Replay script accepts H3D_CAPTURE_FILE to validate actual shader identity. X11 capture viewport differs and its original spatial rectangle is not accepted for correctness.
depthFollowup: Tenth-readback target slowdown isolated and matched to Mesa source; disposable-copy verification fixes the timing harness. Fragment-Z dependence isolated; clip-depth varyings reduce live particle GPU time with an identical captured image. Later controlled boundary fixtures reject direct substitution: strict portal decisions differ, including coplanar and clipped cases. No production cutover.
boundaryFollowup: Three fresh native GLES processes repeat 1296 comparisons each. Float decision/depth outputs agree exactly with independent RGBA8 discard masks. 562 comparisons per run differ between original and candidate; controls and coverage agree. Synthetic diagnostic source and result evidence retained; no server connection or production changes.
cpuFollowup: 20 verified production windows: five alternating pairs with V8 sampling plus five without. Count-only development audits prove all 206 dominant owners enter both shadow cascades and receive descriptors/copies before non-caster rejection. Original shadow-maps preference explicitly restored and saved-state/active-target verified. No production optimization implemented.
